text:
tara: Quick thread — noticed the hosted ingress shim is currently trusting X-Project header if present. What happens when callers omit it or send conflicting values?

devon: Are you referring to the public hosted ingress v0.3 path or the dedicated/private one?

tara: Hosted v0.3. Example:
```
POST /v1/completions
Authorization: ApiKey abc.def.ghi
X-Project: proj:acme:123
```
If X-Project is missing we fall back to the org claim on the key metadata. That fallback worries me.

mike: Fallback is convenient but risky. A forwarder that can inject X-Project could impersonate projects. We need strict binding rules.

elaine: Proposal: only honor client-supplied X-Project when the API key metadata explicitly contains a project claim (e.g., claims:["proj:acme:123"]). Otherwise strip X-Project and use org-level claim or reject. For internal svc tokens we can allow internal headers.

jordan: Also caching implications: our route-level cache keyed on route+api_key could leak across projects. Need to include project_id (or empty) and auth_mode in cache key.

devon: Agree. Cache key suggestion: hash(api_key_id + "/" + project_id + "/" + route + "/" + auth_mode). Short TTL for inferred-project entries to limit blast radius.

auth-bot: scan: 12,374 requests in last 24h where keys lacked X-Project — those currently used org fallback.

mike: Another case: internal forwarders sometimes pass customer keys downstream and add X-Project for routing. If forwarder does that we must require provenance, e.g., X-Origin-Intent signed by forwarder, otherwise strip.

tara: Draft concrete rules to implement:
  • disallow honoring client-supplied X-Project unless API key metadata includes explicit project claim
  • mark requests with shim.project_inferred=true when using org fallback (for telemetry + alerts)
  • cache keys must include project_id and auth_mode (api_key vs svc_token)
  • require forwarders to sign X-Origin-Intent; otherwise strip project header on ingress
  • add unit + integration tests covering forwarded and S2S flows

elaine: SGTM. I'll write a short mini-RFC with examples and a feature flag ingress.strict_project_header for private deployments.

jordan: I'll own the cache change and perf testing — plan to run a 72h replay to measure hit-rate delta.

mike: I'll inventory known forwarders and high-risk services (ingest-gateway, s3-proxy, partner-proxy) and flag any that rewrite Authorization or X-Project.

tara: Telemetry request: include shim.project_source=["explicit","inferred","forwarded","internal"] on logs so we can alert when inferred/forwarded dominates.

elaine: Adding that. Recommend staged rollout: v0.3.1 strip-only behavior, v0.4 enforce claim binding.

mike: +1 on staged rollout, coordinate with support for triage playbook.

tara: Thanks all — I'll follow up with a short doc and link to tests. :raised_hands:
